title: A pure degree class makes a graph reconstructible (t4 Lemma P)
statement_en: Every graph G on at least 3 vertices that has a vertex u whose degree class is pure is reconstructible: pure means that for any two ordered pairs of distinct vertices (x, y), (x', y') with deg x = deg x' = deg u and G - x - y isomorphic to G - x' - y', x ~ y iff x' ~ y'. (Sketch t4 section 4; no source found, attribution UNVERIFIED.)
statement_lean: Recon.ClassReconstructible (fun n G => (∃ u : Fin n, ∀ x y x' y' : Fin n, (G.neighborSet x).ncard = (G.neighborSet u).ncard → (G.neighborSet x').ncard = (G.neighborSet u).ncard → x ≠ y → x' ≠ y' → Nonempty (G.induce ({x, y}ᶜ : Set (Fin n)) ≃g G.induce ({x', y'}ᶜ : Set (Fin n))) → (G.Adj x y ↔ G.Adj x' y')))
